settings.title: A finish that holds up at altitude

settings.editor:
Mountain sun breaks down coatings faster than almost anywhere else. We don't skimp on materials or surface preparation, and we follow each manufacturer's recommendations so your finish looks good and lasts.

Not sure about color? We'll help you choose, taking the light, the setting and the weather into account. A dedicated project lead oversees the work from start to finish.

settings.html:
When is the best time of year for exterior painting?
Late spring through early fall, when temperatures stay within the paint manufacturer's range. We schedule around the weather and keep you updated if a storm moves in.
How long will an exterior paint job last up here?
It depends on exposure. South- and west-facing walls take the most sun and wear fastest. Good preparation and premium products make the biggest difference, and we'll tell you honestly what to expect.
Do you protect landscaping and outdoor surfaces?
Yes. Plants, decks, roofs, windows and anything else near the work are covered and masked before we spray, and we clean up every day.
Do I need to be home during the work?
No. Many of our clients are away. We coordinate access with you or your property manager and send progress photos along the way.
